What would you like to do?

This tool documents how inbound calls travel through PBXware — from the trunk, through DID processing and Operation Times gates, out to every local destination. Start with the reference map, or upload your own configuration exports to see your actual routing.

Load a file to view your call flow map

Drop your PBXware export below — the .xlsx workbook with your DID routing, IVR, Dial Group, ERG, Extension and Operation Hours sheets. It is read entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded anywhere. Pick a DID and its call map is traced in full: DID → IVR → every option → the terminating destination.
